title: Composition-layer audits: provenance erasure, Brave Search, the Prize
description: These claims measure what composition layers do with provenance. TL;DR:013 (#129) holds a reading in which the framework's concepts propagate while its author's name is suppressed; the Self-Audit Module (#780, #156) holds framing substitution the main vector of distortion and specifies a replication procedure. Erasure Skew (#157) and Measurement Sovereignty (#788) specify the Lee Sharks Prize query as a replication, and the Prize announcement (#1196) forecasts the credential surfacing. They specify the single-owner discount panel (#742), the Brave Search replication and audit (#1011, which holds Brave treats operators as suggestions), Stabilized Node Watch for directional drift (#166) and the Revelation First battery (#832, #202); Brave Grey Drool (#150) is an effective act on the same ground, cast as forecasts. The page also holds unrelated claims on a logotic operator, a phrase's origin, surface canonicity and the history of mediation.

claims.statement:
The Meaning Feudalism framework (Sharks 2026a, 2026b) makes a specific empirical prediction that SNW is designed to test: *composition-layer drift on stabilized nodes will be directional rather than random.* Specifically, the framework predicts that, under sustained observation across years, drift will tend to:

- **Consolidate platform jurisdiction.** Renderings will shift toward formulations that present the composition-layer surface as the authoritative knowledge mediator and reduce the visibility of independent sources outside platform-canonized referents.
claims.falsifier: SNW does not assume this prediction is correct. The specification is what makes the prediction *testable*. If the prediction is correct, the federated observational record over a multi-year window will exhibit directional drift consistent with the four patterns above. If the prediction is incorrect, the observational record will exhibit random drift or null drift, falsifying or substantially weakening the Meaning Feudalism framework's claim. Either outcome is empirically valuable.
